GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 095 (8 May 48) CPC/FP
(SCAPIN-1880/1)
APO 500
8 May 1948
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Perpetual Leases
1. Reference is made to memorandum for the Japanese Government, file AG 386.3 (22 Apr 48) CPC/FP, SCAPIN 1880, 22 April 1948, subject, “Procedures for Restoration of Property in Japan to Nationals of the United Nations,” from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
2. Upon restoration of real property to United Nations nationals who held such real property under perpetual leaseholds on or prior to 7 December 1941, the Japanese Government is directed to include in the restoration receipt, at the option of the restore, the following additional provision:
“The acceptance of title to and possession of real property being restored will in no way prejudice any claim or petition that restoree may make against the Japanese Government for the restoration of perpetual leases held on or prior to 7 December 1941.”
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
